_register: Polite です・ます style (敬体) in sentences addressed to the reader, impersonal and without 'you' (no あなた); instructions end in ください (e.g. バーコードを読み取ってください); buttons, menu entries and headings are short nouns or noun + する stems without する (貸出, 返却, 保存, 取り消し); no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Corner brackets 「 」 for quoted titles and names (e.g. 貸出：「{{title}}」), nested quotes 『 』; Japanese full-width punctuation 、 。 and the full-width colon ： in running text; no spaces between Japanese text and Latin letters, digits or {{placeholders}}; the ellipsis … and the arrow → stay; no question-mark or exclamation-mark spacing rules (use ？ full-width in questions, never ！).
_plural: Japanese has no plural: use the single form 'other' everywhere and write the number with the counter that fits the thing counted (冊 for books and copies, 件 for loans, notices and results, 人 for patrons, students and teachers, 日 for days, クラス for classes), with no space between number and counter (e.g. {{count}}冊, {{count}}件).

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; 資料 also covers DVDs and other media, which are item types here (counter 点, or 冊 for books). 「複本」 is not used (it means duplicate copies of the same title).

record.note: Bibliographic record (書誌データ), the standard word in Japanese library systems; a 書誌 has one or more 資料.

patron.note: Standard word in Japanese libraries and software.

card.note: Short form 「カード」 where the context is clear; school libraries also say 貸出カード, but 利用者カード is kept for one term everywhere.

loan.note: Noun and menu word; the verb is 貸し出す (貸出する), counter 件.

return.note: The action: 「返却」 on the menu, 「返却する」 for the verb.

renew.note: Short form 「延長」 on buttons. 「更新」 is also used by library systems, but in school libraries 延長 is plainer and avoids a clash with the 年度更新 of the class upgrade.

due date.note: Short form 「期限」 in table columns.

overdue.note: Also 「延滞中」 for the state; 「期限超過」 is not used.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; the action of reminding is 督促 (in the menu 「督促」).

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS), the term of the Japan Library Association and of school library practice.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and call number on the spine; 「背ラベル」 is the usual Japanese word for the spine label.

label.note: The adhesive barcode label; short form 「ラベル」 where the context is clear (not to be confused with 背ラベル).

class.note: A school class (3 B); 「学級」 is the school word, 「クラス」 is the colloquial one and is avoided. The year is 学年.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for; 「対象学年」 may appear in explanations but the label is 読書レベル.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (NDC, 日本十進分類法, is the Japanese counterpart of Dewey for non-fiction).

catalogue.note: Short form 「蔵書」 in menus and counts (the collection); 「目録」 alone is avoided.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; the standard term in Japanese school libraries.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; the list is 「購入希望リスト」. Not 「リクエスト」, which in Japanese libraries means an interlibrary or reservation request (no holds exist here).

census.note: Registering the patrons with their photo (the 'photo census' page is 「利用者の写真登録」).

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; school library systems also say 「年度更新」 or 「学年更新」, but 進級処理 names exactly what happens (3 B becomes 4 B).

restore.note: Verb 「復元する」; 「リストア」 is not used.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; 「バーコードスキャナー」 is also common, but リーダー is the word used by library systems and avoids confusion with a document scanner.

wizard.term: セットアップウィザード

student.note: Covers 児童 (primary) and 生徒 (secondary), since the program serves any school stage; in a single-stage context a school may prefer 児童 or 生徒. Short form in tight spaces: 「児童・生徒」 is not used.

teacher.note: Teachers; 「教職員」 (all school staff) is used only where non-teaching staff are meant.

school year.note: The school year starting in April (2026年度); 「学年」 means the grade (3年), never the year in time.

administration.note: Menu: 「管理」; the page area 「管理画面」 where needed.

template.note: Print template: 「印刷テンプレート」.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is 「貸出」 (menu word for loans).
